Exercise: Goblet Squat

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
push

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- sagittal_plane_squat

Primary Muscles:

- quadriceps

Secondary Muscles:

- calves
- glutes
- hamstrings
- shoulders

Equipment:

- kettlebells

Fatigue Score:
3

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
0.8

Energy Requirement:
ATP-PC system and glycolytic pathway

Recovery Time:
24 hours

Goals:

- quadriceps_strength_and_hypertrophy
- hamstring_endurance
- glute_activation

Contraindications:

- Recent or chronic knee injuries
- Severe lower back pain

Exercise Variations:

- name: Goblet Front Squat, equipment: kettlebells
- name: Sumo Deadlift High Pull, equipment: kettlebells

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Bodyweight Squat, equipment: none
- exercise_name: Front Squat, equipment: barbell

Instructions:

- Stand holding a light kettlebell by the horns close to your chest. This will be your starting position.
- Squat down between your legs until your hamstrings are on your calves. Keep your chest and head up and your back straight.
- At the bottom position, pause and use your elbows to push your knees out. Return to the starting position, and repeat for 10-20 repetitions.
